canonicalNamespace.provisioningOwner: Joint Root-coordinated one-time publication of existing-file inode manifest; neither consumer recreates missing files
canonicalNamespace.storageDomain: One pinned host domain, not a caller-selected mount or project label
canonicalNamespace.fileContract: Private owned directory; fresh open descriptions; existing regular single-link private files; O_NOFOLLOW; held and visible dev/inode/owner/mode checks before and after nonblocking flock; no LOCK_UN

claims.source: Complete physical leaf/member union from separately qualified trusted local topology provider plus fresh stable volume/topology observations
claims.identityKeys: Canonical lowercase ASCII [a-z0-9][a-z0-9._:-]{0,127}; names are scheduling identities, not publication authority
claims.known: Shared SAME barrier inode + exclusive lanes for sorted deduplicated complete physical-member union
claims.unknown: Exclusive SAME barrier inode; never an independent unknown-device lane
claims.changedOrUnqualified: Use exclusive global barrier or fail before dispatch; no independent-device claim
claims.limits: At most16 before/after volume pairs,32 members per observation,64 union members
doNotInfer: Different st_dev means different physical storage
Different APFS volume/container names means independent disks
SoftRAID virtual disk parent exhaustively identifies physical members
A mounted filesystem identity proves physical topology or mount incarnation

order: existing native/UI lease when job requires it
acquisition.onContention: All stages nonblocking. On contention at ANY stage close every known-open partial native/UI, CPU and IO description before busy/wait. Never wait while holding earlier stages; unknown close retains ownership and prohibits retry.
acquisition.onUnknownClose: Retain owner and known-open descriptors, preserve uncertain numeric descriptor without retry
acquisition.afterDispatch: Hold inherited descriptions through actual direct/nested group and worker settlement; parent terminal collected separately; timeout or process absence is not release proof
acquisition.scope: Photo canonical UI/catalog/IO lease remains separately owned; this grants no Adobe/cache/Main/publication rights

providerExtensibility.apfs: Planned provider must unify sibling volumes/containers that share physical leaves
providerExtensibility.compositeStorage: All qualified RAID/pool/member leaves reserved; incomplete topology uses global fallback
providerExtensibility.zfsAndRefs: Future local providers supply the same complete canonical member contract; no new runtime support claimed

qualificationRequired: Same-physical sibling contention and disjoint-device concurrency in disposable pool
Unknown exclusive barrier conflicts with every known shared-barrier claim
CPU contention releases all IO and partial CPU locks
Late physical-lane contention releases earlier lanes and barrier
Inherited descriptions outlive parent-copy close until actual child closure
Replaced/symlink/aliased files and manifest/topology changes refuse before dispatch
Close uncertainty retains owner without numeric descriptor retry
Both project dispatchers join SAME manifest/barrier before any system-wide IO-coordination claim
Finite simultaneous synthetic IO/latency/memory qualification only after lifecycle and topology qualification
topologyUpdates: Qualified topology/manifest publication requires exclusive canonical barrier, stable barrier inode and no active bulk claims; both consumers must adopt a pinned successor. Missing/stale namespace identity fails before IO; no fallback to a second pool.
jobScope: Complete local bulk jobs or endpoint-local IO phases; no per-phase IO lease across peer-dependent RPC waits. Same-host loopback accounts both endpoints; distributed production admission requires separate deadlock qualification.

requiredEvidence: Qualified collision-resistant persistent leaf identity (e.g. provider-verified WWN/serial+vendor binding), not an unverified display serial
Fresh bounded volume UUID/filesystem identity, mount incarnation evidence, container/store/RAID complete member graph and leaf ancestry
Before/after graph and host/boot identity agreement; command raw receipts and observation times retained
stablePhysicalIdentity.missingOrAmbiguous: EXCLUSIVE same global barrier or refuse; no disjoint physical-lane claim. Stable identity is scheduling scope, not file byte identity.

topologyFreshness.dispatch: After full IO/CPU/native bundle acquisition, reobserve required graph and mount/host/boot bindings before payload dispatch. Change/remount/hotplug/ambiguous/timeout/overflow: release known descriptions and refuse dispatch, never upgrade shared barrier in place. Global fallback requires new whole bundle attempt.
topologyFreshness.duringJob: A topology event or observation uncertainty after dispatch marks outcome unresolved and prevents subsequent phases. Retain ownership through actual child/group settlement; moving to global barrier in place is forbidden. No claim of detecting every hardware event until provider/event monitoring is independently qualified.
topologyFreshness.currentStatus: Proposed thresholds, no qualified provider or event monitor. Metadata snapshots alone cannot authorize physical lanes.
topologyFreshness.ageDefinition: Age measured from OLDEST required observation start to dispatch, never newest command completion. If complete census cannot meet freshness window, refuse known-lane admission or take fresh global fallback bundle.

manifestContract.authority: Root provisions ONCE only after both source consumers agree. Publish exact immutable manifest bytes/SHA, both consumers adopt. Consumers never create/repair/rebind files.
manifestContract.update: Hold exclusive SAME stable barrier; no active claims. Preserve barrier inode forever. Add leaf lanes with no active claims and publish immutable successor manifest; both consumers explicitly adopt. Replacement/loss of barrier requires explicit stop-world recovery, not transparent recreation.

topologyPreparation.authority: User/Photo authorized bounded diskutil/ioreg read-only metadata within Unison00..07. No media payload/SDK/nativePhoto/privateDNG grant.
